localFacts.fact: Destatis (Zahl der Woche, 2. Juni 2026): Frauen in Deutschland sind im Schnitt 1,66 m groß, Männer 1,79 m. Replaces the CDC US average for the eye-level check.

die medienanstalten: a live stream is usually licence-bound (Rundfunkzulassung) when it is linear and journalistically edited along a schedule, or when it reaches more than 20.000 simultaneous users on average over six months; most small streams are zulassungsfrei, but ad labelling and youth protection still apply. General information, not legal advice.
Lufthansa allows one cabin bag of max. 55 x 40 x 23 cm (short and long haul); the Befree Advanced folds to 40 cm, so it fits in that bag.
Vanguard Deutschland lists the EU ALTA PRO 263AB G2 at 171 cm max, 69,5 cm folded, 2,29 kg and 10 kg load, with a multi-angle column (MACC) that moves 0-180 degrees and a hook for accessories.
Local terms: Stativkopf, Kugelkopf, Fluidkopf/Videoneiger, Mittelsäule, Schnellwechselplatte; Arca-Swiss keeps its name.
